preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 20
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 20) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case starts with a line containing a single integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10³), followed by two lines each containing a single string of length N, with only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) == N for N, A, B in parse_test_cases(stdin))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the strings A and B have equal length N, and each character in A and B is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['-1'] or (output_line.isdigit() and int(output_line) >= 0) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either '-1' (impossible) or a non-negative integer K (minimum operations).

postconditions.expression: all((K == -1 and len(operations) == 0) or (K >= 1 and len(operations) == K) for K, operations in parse_output(stdout))
postconditions.description: If K is -1, no operations are printed. Otherwise, exactly K lines follow, each describing one operation with a valid subset S of indices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x < N for x in S.split()) for S in operations if K != -1)
postconditions.description: Each operation's subset S contains distinct indices in the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: all(len(S.split()) == Z for Z, S in parse_operations(operations))
postconditions.description: Each operation line starts with an integer Z (the size of S) followed by Z distinct indices.

postconditions.expression: all(apply_operations(A, operations) == B if K != -1 else False for A, B, operations in zip(parse_A(stdin), parse_B(stdin), parse_operations(stdout)))
postconditions.description: If K is not -1, applying the operations to A must yield B. The operations must be valid (each operation replaces characters in S with the alphabetically smallest character in A[S] at the time of operation).

postconditions.expression: all(min_operations(A, B) == K if K != -1 else min_operations(A, B) == -1 for A, B, K in zip(parse_A(stdin), parse_B(stdin), parse_K(stdout)))
postconditions.description: The output K is the minimum number of operations required to convert A to B, or -1 if it is impossible.
